notes: Weak match. A junior data analyst applying for a mid-level Data Scientist role. Missing Python, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, production ML, statistical modelling and warehouse SQL. Years of experience are well short of the 4+ the JD asks for. The rubric must place this clearly in the weak band, and every core requirement should surface as a high-severity gap.

required_gaps.about: The JD requires strong Python with pandas, scikit-learn and PyTorch. The CV has none of these.
The JD requires at least one ML model shipped to production. The CV has no ML work at all, let alone in production.
The JD asks for 4+ years as a Data Scientist. The CV shows two years as a Data Analyst plus an internship.
SQL is present against a MySQL replica, but the JD asks for warehouse SQL (BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift).
Statistical modelling and experiment design are stated requirements. The CV does not mention either.
